steps.text: Talk to Timfraku upstairs in the western hut north of Tai Bwo Wannai. Wait, then select.
Talk to Lubufu at the fishing spots south of the Brimhaven house portal.
Talk to him again.
chat: 3. I could help collect the bait.
1. You sound like you could do with the help.

steps.text: Talk to him again to give him 20 raw karambwanji.
Talk to him again.
chat: 3. What do you use to catch Karambwan?
2. What do you do with your Karambwan?

steps.text: Wait, then accept his offer to learn how to fish karambwan and receive a karambwan vessel.
Drop the vessel and ask Lubufu for another. Pick up the first vessel so that you have two.
chat: 3. Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

steps.text: Optionally, drop both vessels and repeat the dialogue to obtain a third for use after the quest. Pick up the dropped vessels.
Go to Tiadeche, north-east of fairy ring DKP, and collect the nearby seaweed if needed.
Talk to Tiadeche.
Use a raw karambwanji on a karambwan vessel, then use the baited vessel on Tiadeche.

If you have not prepared the poisoned spear, cook the raw karambwan he gives you to make a poison karambwan. Grind it with a pestle and mortar, then use the karambwan paste on your spear. Ironmen who burn the karambwan need 65 Fishing to catch another.
Go to Tamayu at the mine north-east of fairy ring CKR.
Talk to him twice and watch the cutscene.
Use an agility potion(4) and your karambwan-poisoned spear on him. Make sure he takes both items.
Talk to him again and watch him kill The Shaikahan.
chat: 3. Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan.

steps.text: Kill a nearby monkey using Magic or Ranged and pick up its corpse.
Use the corpse on Tamayu to obtain monkey skin.
Use the seaweed on the skin to make a seaweed sandwich.
Go to Cairn Isle, west of fairy ring CKR. Climb the rocks and walk across the bridge.
Talk to Tinsay and give him the banana rum, seaweed sandwich and marinated jogre bones when requested. Select when prompted.
Use your remaining karambwan vessel, empty or baited, on Tinsay to receive a crafting manual.
Return to Tiadeche near fairy ring DKP. Talk to him, then use the manual on him.
Return to Timfraku and talk to him to complete the quest.
Optionally, talk to the brothers in their houses in southern Tai Bwo Wannai to claim the additional rewards:
Tiadeche, in the south-western house: 5,000 Fishing experience.
Tinsay, in the middle house: 5,000 Cooking experience and the ability to cook karambwan.
Tamayu, in the south-eastern house: 2,500 Attack experience, 2,500 Strength experience and a karambwan-poisoned rune spear.
Congratulations, quest complete!
